author: Clickn
body:
As most of us already know, servers like MineHQ are releasing a client called cheatbreaker, Cheatbeaker, according to the website, is as Followed, " CheatBreaker is a modpack and client-side anticheat combined! In most cases, CheatBreaker more than doubles your normal Minecraft frames!". This sort of thing isn't really new as Badlion Premium and OCMC has done the same, But the thing is, It's 1.7, Badlion Premium is 1.8 but there's a monthly subscription, and I'm pretty sure no one will pay :/ .Plus it only works with badlion I Believe. If most of our players are 1.8, how do we stop cheaters? Well, there is one way, It's probably not possible since avicus isn't that well known but it's worth a shot, What if we make our own little client? 
and you may ask, How? peeps may say that we will need ALOT of devs. But think about hack clients for a moment. One of the most popular clients, called Wurst, was made by only 1 developer and was designed by 1 designer. ALSO, Whats also ironic is that the developer of Vape(a well known ghost client) , Manthe ,WORKED on cheatbreaker, So, hack client developers can be our "friend". Plus, think about the good side of this, less cheaters! I know the risk of less cheaters=less players, but think about what the community wants, I would sacrifice  cheaters for less players  as it will mean that the gamemodes are now clean and people just MIGHT come back. People are always complaining about anticheat this and anticheat that. keenanjt and Kashike could do it :D. Anyways, thats enough for now,  I'm not even sure if I'm supposed to post this topic in Trending Topics, pls nu strike and move it to it's proper place, Maybe next time i will make a mod pack for avicus ;/

~C0mbo
